mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CHAT_PRESENCE ( USER_KEY, ONLINE_YN, SOCKET_SESSION_ID, LAST_ACTIVE_AT ) VALUES ( #{userKey}, 'Y', #{sessionId}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CHAT_PRESENCE SET ONLINE_YN = 'Y', SOCKET_SESSION_ID = #{sessionId}, LAST_ACTIVE_AT = NOW(), UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE USER_KEY = #{userKey}
UPDATE TB_CHAT_PRESENCE SET ONLINE_YN = 'N', UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE SOCKET_SESSION_ID = #{sessionId}
mapper.select:
SELECT P.USER_KEY AS userKey, U.USER_EMAIL AS userEmail, P.ONLINE_YN AS onlineYn, P.SOCKET_SESSION_ID AS socketSessionId, P.LAST_ACTIVE_AT AS lastActiveAt, P.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt
FROM TB_CHAT_PRESENCE P
INNER JOIN TB_USER_MST U ON P.USER_KEY = U.USER_KEY
WHERE P.ONLINE_YN = 'Y'
